method: Six parallel workstreams; preserve original records; evidence and product regulation must be verified individually.

reconciliation.warning: 67 clinical-specific drafts and 20 source-linked structured editorial records measure different datasets; do not combine them or describe 67 as verified.

streams.next: Map canonical ingredient IDs to research drafts, flag missing source-specific citations and safety claims.
Complete indication-specific draft evidence and contraindication fields, never infer unverified doses.
Check clinical draft coverage and provenance at ingredient level.
Prioritize remaining clinical drafts and check interactions, special populations, dose-form distinction.
Verify status per actual product and formulation; unknown until RNE/RNPA/ANMAT or applicable authority verified. Never assume prescription status from ingredient alone.
Reconcile 100 candidate IDs vs canonical library, ES/EN/IT semantic parity, source URLs, audit safety gates, keep recommendation activation disabled.

acceptance: 100 multilingual indication and safety sets reviewed
regulatory status separated by product, form and dose
no public recommendation until clinical and governance signoff
